about: Flipkart publishes its listing templates only inside Seller Hub, per category. These are the fields sellers' guides document for the bulk catalogue template.
Download your category's template from Seller Hub and copy these values into it. Header names in your downloaded template win over the ones here.
Yellow cells are details KaarigarAI doesn't collect: fill them before uploading.

columns.not_collected: your MRP in rupees; Flipkart requires the selling price to be below it

columns.note: check the stock column's exact name in your template

columns.not_collected: how soon you can ship after an order; choose it in Seller Hub
the GST HSN code for your product
GST tax code (Seller Hub guides you to it from the HSN)
barcode, if the product has one
